body:
New research project `research/dispute-arity` (stdlib Python, 10 tests, white paper, experiments) plus README and portfolio page entries.

Key results: optimal arity solves k ln k − k + 1 = a/b (binary only if a/b ≤ 0.386); 1.9–6× cheaper than binary at T=10⁶; adaptive schedules gain ≤1%; leaf-size trade-off; latency as extra round cost.
